name: evaluate-sessions
message: [cron:evaluate-sessions] Check .state/sessions/ for unevaluated sessions (no matching .state/evaluations/ file). For each, delegate to evaluator to score it.

name: analyze-failures
message: [cron:analyze-failures] Delegate to bob: analyze the last 10 evaluations in .state/evaluations/, identify the top recurring pattern, write findings to agents/bob/workspace/analysis.md.
description: Bob analyzes evaluation patterns every 8 hours

name: optimize
message: [cron:optimize] Read agents/bob/workspace/analysis.md. If it contains actionable findings, delegate to optimizer to implement the top recommendation. Only update knowledge/prompt files — no code changes without human approval.
description: Optimizer implements one fix per day from bob's analysis

name: health-check
message: [cron:health-check] Run: npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest --run. Report pass/fail and test count. If anything fails, investigate.
description: Daily tsc + test suite health check

name: coaching
message: [cron:coaching] Check agent scores via .state/evaluations/. If any agent has 3+ sessions below threshold (eff < 0.5 or qual < 0.5), delegate to coach to run exercises on that agent.
description: Weekly coaching for underperforming agents (disabled until more data)

name: lesson-consolidation
message: [cron:lesson-consolidation] Delegate to bob: read all agents/*/knowledge/lessons.md files. Deduplicate, consolidate, remove stale entries. Preserve proven lessons.
description: Weekly lessons.md cleanup (disabled until more data)
